_about: Public Đà Nẵng infrastructure and large projects that can move land prices, seeded by vnrealty/infra/catalog.py::seed_projects. Facts (status, dates, sizes, budgets) carry the citation in `evidence`. `p_done` (chance it completes by `done_year`) and `uplift` (fractional price lift for land right next to it once complete, before distance decay over `radius_km`) are DESK JUDGEMENT, labelled in `basis`, not facts. Coordinates are approximate placements (labelled in basis.latlng) — no article publishes them; null where a single point is meaningless or unknown. Projects with no p_done/uplift are tracked for context only and are not turned into catalysts.

projects.name_vi: Khu đất nền 709 lô Sun Group trên đường Võ Chí Công
projects.name_en: Sun Group 709-lot estate on Võ Chí Công

basis.status: inferred from lots being marketed by brokers in 2026; verify
basis.latlng: approximate point on Võ Chí Công in former Hòa Quý (judgement)
basis.p_done: judgement: large developer, lots already marketed
basis.uplift: judgement: new homes and shops lift nearby land; the 709 lots are also competing supply for a few years

evidence.title: Sun Group Land (broker page): đất nền Sun Group Võ Chí Công
evidence.claim: 709 lots of about 80–234 m² on the Võ Chí Công boulevard (broker marketing, not an official source)

evidence.title: Bảo Đăng Land: đường Võ Chí Công Đà Nẵng
evidence.claim: Võ Chí Công road profile and asking prices along it (broker page)

basis.p_done: judgement: stalled for ~3 decades, capital for the remaining area still being requested
basis.uplift: judgement: student and staff demand for rooms and shops in the same ward
